assets.name: basic_attack
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 8-bit pixel-art RPG attack sprite sheet. Create ONE square transparent PNG atlas with EXACTLY 4 equal quadrants in a strict 2 by 2 grid. Each quadrant is one animation frame, order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. In every quadrant the effect is centered at the exact center of the tile, with generous transparent margins and entirely contained within its tile. Treat each tile as an enlarged 64 by 64 pixel drawing: crisp square pixel clusters, stepped contours, small limited palette, solid opaque colored pixels only, hard edges. No anti-aliasing, gradients, blur, bloom, soft glow, shadows, characters, scenery, text, labels, boxes, dividing lines or checkerboard. Background must be genuine alpha transparency. Every quadrant has an isolated visual effect. Consistent retro handheld game artwork. Subject: A basic physical claw strike for a friendly dinosaur RPG hero, NOT an elemental technique. Exactly three short parallel curved ivory-white claw slash crescents with a restrained amber edge and very dark navy outline, pointing down-right. Frame 0 small white preparatory spark; frame 1 three compact white slashes; frame 2 three clearly separated longer curved claw slash crescents; frame 3 compact white and pale gold impact starburst with a few tiny square fragments. Clean small bold readable silhouette, 5 colors. No hand, arm, body, letters, weapon, flames or background.
